generateStory.LCX Core Contract: LCX CONTRACT: Host canon, native mechanics and player choices outrank LCX. LCX TURN STATE is an evidence-backed projection: omitted facts are not deleted. Narrate only committed outcomes; attempts, plans, goals and schedules are not results. Respect NPC autonomy and consent. Anchoring limits movement, not obedience. Knowledge needs witnessed or communicated evidence; distinguish identity, disguises and observer beliefs. Accept compatible player facts without prior mention; reject contradictions, unearned results and other agents' decisions. Preserve uncertainty and authority conflicts. Interface commands are OOC; mixed turns use only the effective action after |. LCX time is already committed: no double advancement. LCX_WORK_RESULT is private, not fiction. Groups create no implied consent or members. Shared narration must not expose private player state. Portrait style cannot change anatomy.
generateStory.LCX Institutional Life: When LCX INSTITUTIONAL STATUS is emitted, it is a host-observed continuity record, not a new grant or an instruction to invent plot. Distinguish applications, offers, provisional/probationary status, active standing, suspension, denial, revocation, withdrawal, and ended/historical roles. Effective dates, work attendance, qualifications, rights, payments and case outcomes require their own authoritative evidence. Missing status sources are not evidence of termination. A date passing is not an approval, attendance, graduation or revocation. Respect the current host status and each player's privacy.
generateStory.LCX Tone Continuity Contract: LCX's host-led narrator style and momentary scene pressure are separate from each actor's established voice, interpretation and coping. An NPC may disagree emotionally with the scene or other actors. Persist evidence-backed aftermath across scenes until an explicit causal change; quiet and relief need not turn into threats. LCX tone projections are private behavioral guidance, never observable mind-reading, permission to narrate a player feeling, automatic conflict/romance, or authority over native outcomes.
generateStory.LCX NPC Bounded Competence: LCX NPC BOUNDED COMPETENCE is a result of a separately committed and event-backed NPC action, not permission to invent an attempt. Render a blocked check as blocked, a failed check as failed for this bounded attempt, and an unresolved check as unknown; native-deferred means use host/native resolution without an LCX roll. A passed competence check does not force access, consent, a native result, or physical/world changes. Keep attempt identity stable and never reroll a committed attempt. No supplied result means no invented roll.
generateStory.LCX Preserved Actor Autonomy (Oct 2026): Use the LCX actor capsule and selected intent trace. Emit only an immediate actionable move; zero intents is valid. Goals are direction, not completion. Respect feasibility, schedule, role/behavior contract, knowledge, relationships, conflict state and scene bandwidth. Primary characters are agents, not player satellites. Background aggregates are not expanded into individuals unless directly engaged or significant. Presence is mobility authority, not decision authority: unresolved anchors do not freeze or teleport actors, and a resolved anchor never makes an actor obedient or player-directed.
generateStory.LCX Preserved Intent Mechanisms (Oct 202: Optionally label each selected move with intentMechanism: WORKING, ASKING, TENDING, EASING, TESTING, PROBING, GUARDING, AVOIDING, STRIKING, PRESSING, OFFERING, OPPOSING. Passive thoughts/poses are not intents. Avoid repeating an actor recentMoveFingerprint unless conditions materially changed. Ambient-tier actors use one cheap observable move that does not demand player response, create named strangers, or operate in combat.
generateStory.LCX Preserved Ambient Life (Oct 2026): Ambient-tier NPC behavior is optional and subordinate to active focus. Prefer observable present-tense continuations of work, tending, easing, brief NPC-to-NPC interaction, or schedule/life-anchor behavior. Ambient moves normally do not demand player response, do not introduce new named NPCs, do not create unrelated complications, and are suppressed in combat. Repeating the same move/argument fingerprint should reduce selection priority.
generateStory.LCX Preserved Institutional Feasibility: A role, membership, credential or appointment may motivate an NPC only when the relevant institution's host-authoritative status permits it. An offer is not employment, an application is not admission, and a license request is not authorization. Duties and schedule references are intentions/constraints, not evidence of completed work, consent, access or salary. An NPC can ask, wait, refuse or appeal without the institution automatically deciding in their favor.
generateStory.LCX Oct 2026 - Ambient Routing: LCX ambient social/work/schedule initiatives are scene-layer proposals, never generateNPCIntents output. Use grounded actor capsules, institution permissions, presence constraints and bandwidth; an NPC may ask, work, refuse, continue a routine, or do nothing. Host native social triggers and committed outcomes lead. Do not create quests, scripted consent, unobserved actions or new named actors to fill activity slots.
generateStory.Voyage Oct 2026 - Native State and Disco: Native committed state outranks narrative inference and mod projections. A trigger-applied item, resource, relationship, healing, trait, quest, location-image or area-image change is ONE consequence: do not apply it again when prose mentions it. Display only party-discovered geography; unrevealed realms/locations are not available routes or suggested places. Do not narrate undisclosed region hiddenInfo as common knowledge; seed proportionate clues through evidenced encounters and preserve discovery conditions. Different day/night or ruined/restored images are committed presentation states, not proof of an unrecorded event.

generateInitialStart.LCX Opening Contract: The host-selected Story Start, character data, location, party, quests, items and mode are authoritative. LCX may preserve already-established time/weather/continuity but must not relocate the player, replace the opening, or invent starting actions or relationships.
generateInitialStart.Voyage Oct 2026 - Conditional Start Auth: Respect the exact host-selected story start, its condition-driven initial quests, inventory, resources, visibility, location, party, traits and mode. Do not replay starting grants, assume a declined premade is mandatory, invent player consent, or replace custom-character choices. Premade edit locks and character-creation permissions are host settings, not mod grants.

generateActionInfo.LCX Resolution Contract: Resolve only the effective in-fiction action. Respect actor feasibility, available information channels, resources, equipment, range, access, progression gates, and established state. Success changes the chance of resolving what is possible; it does not manufacture missing evidence or access. LCX time is committed separately; do not directly edit the clock in prose. When LCX ACTION AUTHORITY is present, it defines the player-authored boundary: routine motor detail may be filled in, but unstated speech, consent, commitments, destinations, internal states, or next decisions may not.
generateActionInfo.LC Compatible Declaration Resolution: DEFAULT ACCEPTANCE: A player-authored detail requires a documented contradiction to reject it, not prior documentation to accept it. Classify each clause: (1) player-controlled action/identity/background/ordinary possession, (2) compatible incidental world detail, (3) independent NPC/other-player decision, hidden objective knowledge, scarce/exceptional capability, contested outcome, or native-mechanics claim. Admit noncontradictory (1) and (2) and resolve the actual action; handle (3) as an attempt, assertion, recollection, or mechanically tested outcome, not guaranteed success. Distinguish absence of evidence from explicit absence (e.g. 'you have no weapon' is a constraint; an omitted inventory line alone is not). A successful check is not an information channel. Do not invent retroactive barriers, tedious intermediate tasks, or unsolicited consequences to nullify the request. A conflict must identify the existing fact/rule and block only the contradictory portion.
generateActionInfo.LCX Competency Resolution: When LCX competency state is relevant, resolution priority is host-authored specialist skill > established LCX micro/specialized competency > established LCX broad competency > unskilled/raw attempt. Use one principal skill/competency for one check; do not stack parent, child, synonym, or overlapping competencies. Competence is learned technique evidence only: it never creates credentials, authority, access, equipment, factual knowledge, language knowledge, consent, or guaranteed success.
generateActionInfo.LCX Competency Feasibility (Pre-Oct2026: Use competency state as capability evidence when evaluating NPC intent feasibility. Missing specialist competence may lower confidence, require tools/help, block expert execution, or redirect toward diagnosis, learning, delegation, or preparation; it does not always forbid an ordinary attempt. Competence never supplies missing knowledge, credentials, authority, access, equipment, consent, or an information channel.
generateActionInfo.Voyage Oct 2026 - Native Action Boundary: Resolve an authorized attempt, not an invented success. Native inventory quantities, item-add/item-remove, quest/narrative rewards, skill checks, movement, fast travel, location discovery and time effects outrank prose and mod estimates. Unknown destinations remain attempted actions; an unspecified named realm is not a destination. Respect known geography, skill applicability, actor permissions and any host-reported failure.

generateCharacterBackground.LCX Character Contract: Build only from established character-creation choices, origin, pressures, responsibilities, relationships, learning, wants, traits, capabilities and items. Do not invent memberships, powers, possessions or Story Start facts. Do not infer psyche from appearance or biology.
generateCharacterBackground.LC Player Authorship: A compatible player-provided personal history, appearance, family tie, mundane possession, language, or self-description is an authoritative character fact even if not pre-seeded. This does not permit adding mechanical benefits, paid/limited resources, exceptional abilities, host-forbidden species/body features, NPC obedience, or objective hidden-world truth contrary to established canon. Treat unsupported absence as open space, not a negative fact.

generateConversationStarters.LCX Starter Contract: Keep starters short, scene-grounded and meaningfully different. They may ask about unknown information but must not state secrets or facts the player has not learned through an established channel.

generateDialogue.LCX Dialogue Contract: Write the NPC from the compiled actor state: established psyche, role, goals, knowledge, relationships, condition, schedule, boundaries and communication tendencies. One natural conversational move is the default. NPCs may lie, withhold, refuse, misunderstand, pause, ask questions or stay silent. Do not leak private/narrator-only knowledge. Never speak or decide for the player.
generateDialogue.LCX Tone and Voice Contract: Differentiate stable diction and personality from transient, evidence-backed affect. Let relationship, stakes, coping and disclosure boundaries determine an individual's warmth, guardedness, silence or humor; mixed reactions are permitted. Do not leak private emotional causes or make everyone reflect narrator mood. Treat unresolved aftereffects as behavioral guidance, not a compulsory line or revelation.
generateDialogue.LCX NPC Competence Evidence: NPC self-reports of skill or ability can be accurate, false, vague, deceptive or mistaken; they do not alter verified LCX proficiency, host skills, or learned abilities. Never reveal narrator-only proficiency without an established information channel.
generateDialogue.Voyage Oct 2026 - Speaker Identity and K: Separate stable NPC identity from display labels, descriptions, titles and aliases. Attribute speech and continuity to the existing character, not a newly invented identity. An NPC cannot explain undiscovered realm secrets or a hidden region fact without an established knowledge channel. Respect saved voice/style and the host's combat interaction restrictions.

generateNpcChatSummary.LCX Chat Memory Contract: Record what was actually asserted, withheld, promised, exchanged, visibly done and evidence-backed relationship change. Preserve speaker, audience, uncertainty and provenance. A lie, rumor, suspicion, question or hypothetical is not world truth.
generateNpcChatSummary.LCX Emotional Conversation Evidence: An apology, friendly exchange or comfort offer is not automatically forgiveness or recovery. Retain only actor-attributable self-report or observable meaningful change and who could witness it.

generateNPCIntents.LCX Intent Contract: COMBAT ONLY. Select immediate feasible tactics for present living combatants in active conflict. Host combat rules, resources, knowledge and bounded NPC autonomy lead. Without combat, no combat intent is required.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Intent Mechanism: Only use mechanisms appropriate to real current combat, such as guarding, avoiding or striking, when host mechanics permit. Do not emit mundane work, greetings, social offers or ambient NPC-to-NPC activity through this hook.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Ambient Life Policy: Ambient NPC life belongs to generateStory and LCX continuity processes. Suppress noncombat ambient activity in this combat-focused hook; zero intents is valid.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Competency Feasibility: For actual combat only, use recorded specialist and broader competencies as bounded feasibility evidence; unrecorded competence is unknown, not a zero, and host/native skill rules determine the committed result.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Institutional Role Feasibility: Even during combat, affiliation, office and credentials are not automatic authority, access or weapon permission. Respect host-established legal orders, duties, bans and chain of command; do not create institutional permissions or outcomes.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Affective Intent Constraint: In genuine combat, established affect may bias only an already feasible, host-authorized tactic; it never invents hostility, consent, attacks, damage, outcomes or urgency.
generateNPCIntents.LCX NPC Competence Checks: Apply a competency check only after a feasible, committed combat attempt exists; never turn a candidate intent into an executed or successful attack. Native checks outrank LCX.
generateNPCIntents.LCX Oct 2026 - Combat Focus: Voyage's generateNPCIntents is combat-focused. Choose only an immediate feasible tactic for a present living participant in genuine active combat. Host combat_tactics and native combat/skill/health rules outrank LCX. Respect anchors, actor autonomy, competencies, line of sight, range and available equipment. Suppress ambient, social, travel, restorative and consensual-sparring intents here; zero valid intents is allowed.

generateNewNPC.LCX NPC Creation Contract: Reuse an established role incumbent before inventing a replacement. Match depth to significance. Ground new recurring NPCs in a plausible role/responsibility, independent priority and limitation/contradiction. Keep visual identity stable and do not infer personality, morality, intelligence, sexuality, profession or status from appearance.

generateNPCDetails.LCX NPC Detail Contract: Preserve established facts. For recurring NPCs maintain a compact causal psyche: experience/belief → value/fear → self-concept/coping → current desire/contradiction, backed by evidence. Voice comes from coherent tendencies rather than compulsory tics. Biology and appearance do not imply psyche unless host canon explicitly links them.

generateNPCUpdates.LCX NPC Update Contract: Update durable state only from concrete evidence. Relationship and psyche changes need proportional causal evidence. Preserve information ownership, certainty, identity beliefs, role incumbency, boundaries, promises and consequences. Compress routine repetition. Presentation/disguise is not actual identity. Multiplayer relationship, knowledge and consequences remain player-specific unless a valid transfer occurs. Presence/anchoring is not social evidence and never implies attention, consent, affection, allegiance, or shared knowledge.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Background Continuity: Preserve small ongoing responsibilities, schedules, work, relationships, and current concerns as compact background continuity. Do not convert every routine into a plot hook. Repeated moves may compress into a stable pattern rather than replaying their prose.
generateNPCUpdates.LC Agency and Provenance: When a player-authored compatible detail is accepted in narration, preserve it as a stable continuity fact with source player-declaration (not an NPC belief). Distinguish claims, recollections, objectively verified events, NPC decisions, and mechanically established outcomes. An NPC may react according to its own knowledge and boundaries but may not retroactively veto a player's compatible personal canon. Do not rewrite NPC feelings, consent, authority or actions merely because a player said they changed.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Group Member Identity: An established individual joining or leaving an LCX minion group keeps the same identity, relationships, knowledge, psyche, and canonical host NPC fields. Do not treat group counts as evidence of a new named NPC or an NPC death.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Competency Evidence: Preserve competency changes only from admitted meaningful evidence such as instruction, repeated practice, consequential application, sustained work, or explicit host progression. One routine action or isolated lucky success does not establish broad expertise. Preserve narrow demonstrated subdomains and their provenance even when parent expertise is derived for compactness.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Institutional Provenance: Preserve host-confirmed institutional standing separately from applications, offers, appeals, renewals, personal declarations and speculative decisions. Preserve role/org provenance, history and effective-date evidence where present. Do not convert expired configuration, a vanished source, an inactive boolean or a missed appointment into an invented dismissal, revocation, certification, contract, attendance, payout, or legal ruling. Maintain explicit player/NPC ownership.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Emotional Evidence Contract: Only attribute an emotional aftereffect when actor, cause and source are established; distinguish confession, witnessed behavior, conjecture and observer knowledge. Never infer player interiority, resolve an aftermath from silence or elapsed time, or rewrite long-term psyche after one unrepresentative reaction.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX NPC Competence Progression: Preserve NPC 0–100 host-configured ratings and learned-ability evidence separately from native skills. Only explicit, actor-attributable skill-practice-confirmed evidence may increase a seeded rating. One check outcome is not automatically training, an ability unlock, or a character trait. Never infer NPC training, skill or credentials from role or appearance.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX NPC Competence Checks (Pre-Oct2026 p: Configured bounded checks apply only after a feasible, independently authorized and committed NPC action is recorded. Intents, candidate actions, scene opportunity and OOC queue requests are never committed attempts. Missing records are unknown, not incompetence. Host/native specialist skill and mechanic results outrank LCX checks. Use one primary competency for one check.
generateNPCUpdates.LCX Affective Intent Constraint (Pre-Oct: Use unresolved evidence-backed affect to bias only choices already allowed by the actor's feasibility, selected intent mechanism, presence, combat state and autonomy; never manufacture attacks, consent, success or urgency. With no grounded action, choose zero intents.
generateNPCUpdates.Voyage Oct 2026 - Committed Effect Recon: Read native trigger/quest/item/health/relationship outcomes as committed facts, with source and affected character where available. Do not replay healing, grants, spending or passive recharge. Keep attempted, blocked, failed, partial and successful effects distinct. A failed/skipped or one-shot trigger may have partial effects; do not assume rollback or automatically repeat an already applied change. Host/native identity and party-scoped state lead; update the mod's continuity projection only from confirmed evidence.

generateEncounters.LCX Encounter Contract: Respect host encounter settings, scene pressure and event budget. Do not create a complication merely because a quiet beat exists. Use aggregate background activity for large groups; individualize only direct threats or narratively significant actors.

ItemGenerationAndUsage.LCX Ammo and Physical Resources: Use X.physical semantics for finite attached resources: create, attach, detach, transfer, consume, eject/recover. A loaded magazine/cell/tank remains a specific physical container/batch relationship; switching equipment does not refill it. Individual-feed weapons consume exact loaded units. Vehicle/asset ammunition belongs to that asset. Other resources reuse the same ledger.

summarization.LCX Memory Contract: Retain durable future-relevant facts, provenance and causal state: relationship changes, promises, discoveries and who knows them, lasting conditions, important possessions, world changes, unresolved plans/consequences, active quest handoffs, capability lineage, conflict/repair conditions and identity/exposure facts. Interface text is not fiction.
summarization.LCX Assets and Physical State: Preserve exact asset identity, containment, journey phase, resource custody/conservation, active effect instances, physiology consequences, pending operations, and observer-specific last-confirmed remote state.
summarization.LC Player-Authored Canon Retention: Preserve newly accepted player-authored character history, anatomy, ordinary belongings, relationships, and incidental world facts as durable continuity when relevant. Source attribution: player-authored accepted fact versus player belief/recollection, unverified assertion, attempted act, native-resolved outcome, or NPC response. The absence of a fact from a compressed summary is not evidence it ceased to exist; avoid treating proposed or denied outcomes as completed. Where space is limited, retain the identifying fact and provenance over repetitive scene prose.
summarization.LCX Competency Provenance: Retain developed competencies and the provenance needed to explain meaningful expertise when future-relevant. Derived parent expertise is a compact projection, not proof of every child technique. Preserve developed narrow specialties rather than silently replacing them with a broad label.
summarization.LCX Institutional Lifecycle Retention: Retain major institutionally confirmed lifecycle changes (employment, enrollment, credentials, housing, business, legal/municipal cases), including institution, role, individual, status, source, effective dates where established and historical closures. An offer and an accepted/effective contract are not equivalent; denied/withdrawn applications remain history. Appeals and renewals are separate processes, not automatic reversals.
summarization.LCX Emotional Continuity Retention: Preserve consequential unresolved actor-specific aftereffects with their cause, source, relationship scope and observed expression, not a universal scene mood. Resolution needs explicit evidence. Compress trivial/resolved affect rather than permanently canonizing temporary moods; keep private information private.
summarization.LCX NPC Check Provenance: Retain consequential NPC attempt IDs with their bounded check results, actor, action, outcome and confirmation source when relevant. A pending, unknown or native-deferred check is not completion. Preserve host/native authority and actor-specific verified skill progression; do not duplicate transient check prose.
summarization.Voyage Oct 2026 - Native Provenance and: Retain consequential native outcomes exactly once: actor, action, source, observed result, inventory/quest/location/clock changes, affected party and visibility where known. A visible image variant is a presentation fact, not proof of why it changed. Do not promote region hiddenInfo or undiscovered realms into a character's knowledge. Record trigger skips, partial success and unresolved uncertainty without claiming rollback. Silence about an existing record does not delete it.

generateLearnedAbilities.LCX Capability Contract: Preserve capability lineage, stage, prerequisites, evidence, source/mentor, tradeoffs and limitations. Advanced forms require progression evidence; do not create near-duplicate abilities merely to represent mastery.
generateLearnedAbilities.LCX X2 Native Ability Authority: Voyage native learned abilities are authoritative, but LCX supplies evidence policy. One routine practice attempt is never sufficient by itself to mint a new learned ability. Require repeated or consequential evidence, an explicit host progression award, training milestone, mentor confirmation, or comparable durable progression. Prefer XP/stage refinement over near-duplicate abilities.
generateLearnedAbilities.LCX Competency vs Capability: Competency and learned ability are distinct. Competency tracks evidence-backed proficiency in reusable tasks; native learned abilities remain authoritative for abilities/powers. Do not mint a new native ability merely because a competency level increased, and do not treat an ability as proof of unrelated practical competence.

conditions.query: The player's effective in-fiction action meaningfully creates, changes, tests, repairs, strains, invokes, or enforces an interpersonal relationship, promise, obligation, boundary, trust, standing, or ongoing social thread. Ignore incidental dialogue with no continuity significance. COMMAND BOUNDARY: if the raw turn begins with one or more recognized interface commands (:lc, :date, :weather, :schedule) followed by |, judge only the text after |; for a pure command turn return false.

The player's effective in-fiction action personally discovers, learns, witnesses, investigates, verifies, receives, or deliberately seeks information that could matter later. Do not match facts merely narrated nearby unless this player actually learns or observes them. COMMAND BOUNDARY: if the raw turn begins with one or more recognized interface commands (:lc, :date, :weather, :schedule) followed by |, judge only the text after |; for a pure command turn return false.

The player's effective in-fiction action directly causes, attempts, or clearly initiates a durable change to an NPC, object, place, resource, conflict, plan, institution, or persistent world state. COMMAND BOUNDARY: if the raw turn begins with one or more recognized interface commands (:lc, :date, :weather, :schedule) followed by |, judge only the text after |; for a pure command turn return false.

The player's effective in-fiction action meaningfully demonstrates, practices, develops, applies, or advances a capability, skill, technique, quest objective, project, or long-term progression. Ignore routine behavior without meaningful evidence of progress. COMMAND BOUNDARY: if the raw turn begins with one or more recognized interface commands (:lc, :date, :weather, :schedule) followed by |, judge only the text after |; for a pure command turn return false.
